Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
At Mindera, we craft software with people we love. 💛
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and run the pipelines and platforms that move our customers' data: from source systems to the warehouse, on production systems with real consequences.
We value empathy, self-organization, and the courage to take risks. If you love solving complex problems and believe that teaching others is the best way to learn, you'll feel right at home here.
We're looking for someone who loves to build, learn, and guide others. You'll be working closely with our leadership (CEO/COO) and our clients, so clear communication and a collaborative spirit are key.
At Mindera, we encourage the use of AI to assist with coding and related tasks. We find that a person's engineering and software craft skills have a big impact on long-term successful delivery, with or without AI. Our goal in the interview process is to understand the candidate's knowledge and skills in engineering. If you need to, or plan to use AI, please be transparent with us when you're using it, to avoid issues and misunderstandings that can either impact your chance of securing the role or impact your success at Mindera.
When you join Mindera we welcome you into a fun and politics-free work culture, built on the principles of lean and self-organisation .
 Note: Depending on the project and our clients' needs, you may get the chance to pack your bags and take off every now and then. Typically, we estimate travel time to be between 0% and 15%.
 HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT:
Pipeline Engineering: Build and operate robust ingestion pipelines (both batch and streaming) from databases, event streams, and third-party APIs
Storage & Performance: Own storage architecture across the lake, lakehouse, and warehouse, optimizing for partitioning, cost efficiency, and query speed
Reliability & Observability: Keep pipelines observable and restartable by implementing orchestration, automated testing, alerting, and ensuring clean recovery when something breaks at 08:00
Engineering Best Practices: Work like a true software engineer by implementing infrastructure as code, CI/CD for data workloads, code reviews, and strict version control
Data Contracts & Governance: Agree on data contracts with data-producing teams to keep schema drift under control, while managing access, retention, and lineage
Lasting Documentation: Produce clear and comprehensive documentation that ensures your work outlives the engagement
 Requirements
 We're Looking for Someone Who:
Has Proven Production Experience: You have built and ran data pipelines in production—and, more importantly, you can articulate what you learned when they broke
Is an AI-Augmented Engineer: You seamlessly integrate AI tooling into your daily workflow, but you maintain the strict review discipline to verify what it generates before it ships
Is a Confident Communicator: You possess fluent English and are completely comfortable working directly with customer teams
Has a Cost Engineering Mindset (Valued): You know how to make a pipeline cheaper and can quantify the savings
Understands Compliance (Valued): You have exposure to regulated environments, including GDPR obligations, access control, and auditable lineage
 Your Technical Toolkit:
Core Languages: Advanced, production-grade SQL and Python
Cloud Platforms: Production depth in one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with a solid grasp of principles to move between them. (A second cloud platform is a plus)
Orchestration: Production experience with an orchestrator from a main vendor (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent)
Warehousing & Transformation (Nice to have): Warehouse depth in Snowflake or BigQuery (dimensional or Data Vault modelling), and experience with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks
Processing & Streaming (Nice to have): Spark or PySpark at scale, Databricks, and streaming/pub-sub brokers like Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or MQTT-class brokers
AI Data Infrastructure & Formats (Nice to have): Embedding pipelines, vector stores, retrieval feeds, feature stores, and open table/file formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Delta)
DevOps & Quality (Nice to have): Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and data quality frameworks in production (Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo)
Source Systems (Nice to have): NoSQL stores (like MongoDB) and marketing/ad-platform data (Google Ads, Meta, CRM platform APIs)
 Benefits
 THE PERKS OF BECOMING A MINDER:
Private medical subscription
Private medical subscription for children
Counseling and psychotherapy services
Reimbursement for eyeglasses
Self-proposal salary process
Annual profit distribution, subject to company performance and board decision
Mindera Unit Plan
Flexible benefits options (sports, medical, cultural, donations)
Trainings and learning opportunities to grow within your role
Coaching and development guidance
25 days holiday
Flexibility to choose where you work from
Vacation incentive
Parties, gatherings & trips 
 WHY MINDERA?
 We're thrilled to have the opportunity to share with you what it's like to be a part of the Mindera community.
We're a group of friendly and talented individuals who work together to bring projects to life, in a fun, politics-free environment.
Our culture is all about being adaptable and self-organized. We want Minders to take risks, make decisions, work together and feel free to be their most authentic selves, every single day.
We work closely with our clients to truly understand their products and develop high-performance, resilient, and scalable software systems that make a real impact for their users and businesses, worldwide.
We are proud of our work, we're always learning and growing in our Agile and collaborative environment, and we hope you'll love it here just as much as we do!
